features.title: Host/Origin guards on gate write endpoint
features.user_visible_behavior: POST /api/gates/decide returns 403 and does not invoke asdd when Host or Origin/Referer is not the loopback UI origin.
features.evidence: Post-copy tweak: tests 10/10 after index/banner update.

features.title: List pending gate decisions in the UI
features.user_visible_behavior: GET /api/gates and the Gates tab show pending WARN gates per slice with concerns/evidence and drift status.
features.evidence: Post-copy tweak: tests 10/10 after index/banner update.

features.title: Decide gates via asdd gate-decide
features.user_visible_behavior: A human can decide a pending gate from the UI; the server spawns asdd gate-decide (decided_by from git/HARNESS_AUTHOR + mandatory note); failures show command output and record nothing via the server.
features.evidence: Post-copy tweak: tests 10/10 after index/banner update.
